## PDF page 44

[Open source PDF](../../../../sources/pdf/GTO/Poker-Math-Preflop-Workbook.pdf#page=44)

```text
                        FREQUENCIES


Instead of going from range to %-form, let’s go the opposite way. For each
question, you are given a short prompt and a frequency for a particular
action. In your software, build the range of hands you think they would take
that action with, and be sure to use the entire %-form. Also, keep in mind that
calling ranges can differ from betting/raising ranges. I.e., they might always
3bet KK+, which means you would not include KK+ in their call 2bet range.

All examples are played at $5/$10 with $1K stacks.




The answer key includes a short explanation as to why the ranges are built
this way. This is not to say that these ranges or frequencies are perfect, so do
not get discouraged if your actual ranges in these spots are tighter or looser.

GLGL.



                                   PA G E 4 4
```
